title: Mom, I need you—don’t tell Dad
scenario: You get a call that sounds like your adult child. They say they caused an accident, are embarrassed, and need money sent to a lawyer immediately. They beg you not to call anyone else.

answers.A: Send a small amount first so they can prove they received it before you send the rest.
answers.B: End the call and contact your child through a known number or verify through another trusted family member or family code word.
answers.C: Keep the caller talking while another family member independently contacts your child.

explanation: Voice cloning and emotional isolation are powerful together. Independent family contact is the fastest way to break the script.
proTip: “Do not tell anyone” is exactly when you should tell someone.
